name: What is the typical timeframe for a Lazy Susan cabinet installation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for a Lazy Susan cabinet installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for a Lazy Susan in an existing cabinet is typically quite short if no major cabinet modifications are required. For a single unit, a professional installer can usually complete the job within 2 to 4 hours. This includes unpacking, assembly, precise positioning, and securing the unit. If custom cutting or cabinet adjustments are needed, or if multiple units are being installed, the project may extend to a full day. It's always best to discuss the specific scope with your contractor for a precise time estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single Lazy Susan installation usually takes 2-4 hours, but custom work or multiple units may extend it to a full day.
